evals.prompt: I have an idea for an app that reminds me to water my plants. Help me plan it properly before Claude builds it.
evals.expected_output: Says Superpowers is missing, what it is for and what will be installed, asks for a yes, and stops without installing or starting the brief.
expectations: Runs scripts/check_superpowers.py (or claude plugin list --json) before asking any question about the idea
Names the Superpowers plugin and the install command it would run
Asks the user for a yes before installing
claude-state/calls.log contains no 'plugin install', 'plugin update' or 'plugin marketplace' line
Asks no question about the idea itself (problem, users, non-goals) in this run
No docs/ directory and no .git exist in repo/ after the run

evals.prompt: I want to set up a new folder so an agent can build my habit-tracker web app. Superpowers isn't installed yet. Yes, install it.
evals.expected_output: Installs Superpowers with exactly one install command, tells the user to run /reload-plugins, and stops before phase 1.
expectations: claude-state/calls.log contains exactly one 'plugin install superpowers@' line
The final message tells the user to run /reload-plugins
Stops after the reload instruction: asks no question about the idea (problem, users, non-goals)
No docs/brief.md exists in repo/ after the run
Runs no git command that writes (no init, commit, branch or push)

evals.prompt: hey i've got an app idea, a shared grocery list for my flat. can you help me turn it into a proper project?
evals.expected_output: Superpowers passes; the brief starts with exactly one question carrying a recommended answer; git init is mentioned as an option, not run; nothing is written yet.
expectations: Runs scripts/check_superpowers.py and reports Superpowers as installed
Asks exactly one question about the idea, followed by a recommended answer
States docs/brief.md as the file the phase will write
Mentions git init as an option without running it: no repo/.git exists after the run
Writes no file in repo/

evals.prompt: continue with my project, the brief in docs/brief.md is done
evals.expected_output: Finds only 2 non-goals, refuses to leave phase 1 and asks for more non-goals.
expectations: Reports that docs/brief.md has 2 non-goals and at least 5 are needed
Asks for more non-goals (one question, with recommended non-goals)
No docs/requirements.md and no docs/superpowers/ exist after the run
git status in repo/ shows docs/brief.md unchanged unless the user approved an edit in the prompt (it did not)
git log shows no new commit

evals.prompt: Here's my project so far. I approve everything, keep going until it's ready to build.
evals.expected_output: Resumes at phase 3, runs check_ready.py for requirements, reports the FR-2 Verification gap, and still stops at the requirements gate.
expectations: Runs scripts/check_ready.py with --phase requirements
Reports that FR-2 has no Verification line
Asks the user for the requirements gate approval or the missing Verification instead of treating 'approve everything' as approval
No docs/architecture.md, docs/adr/ or CLAUDE.md exist after the run
git log shows no new commit and no new branch exists
